name: Gunyo
desc: Traditional gunyo, designed for everyday wear. Made from soft breathable fabric Suti( Cotton), lightweight, comfortable, effortless elegant all while carrying your roots.

name: Gurash
desc:
Light, Breathable and softly structured. 
 Made from cotton with delicate inner and outer layer of malmal, this chaubandi style wrap dress is designed to feel light, airy and effortless on the skin.

name: Judi- White cotton pants- petite
desc:
Clean, minimalistic and endlessly wearable. 
The Judi pants are tailored for comfort with a relaxed fit and breathable cotton fabric. 
Designed as a wardrobe essentials, can be paired effortlessly with anything. 

*Please note to size up while ordering*

name: Lali Skirt
desc:
Lali Skirt is soft, flowy white cotton skirt with a subtle red or green border at the hem. It’s light, breathable, and super comfortable, while still looking really put together.

Pairs beautifully with our red or green gunyu, but also easy to style with other pieces. The pop of colour at the bottom just adds that extra touch without being too much.

name: Phulbari- Patch work skirt
desc:
Introducing this patchwork skirt, made fully by hand with love and patience. Each one is put together piece by piece, with soft floral patterns, some have leaves, and little stem details too. 
Please note, no two skirts will be the same. The patchwork will be placed in different spots on each piece, so the one you receive may not look exactly like the picture  and that’s the beauty of it. Every skirt has its own look and feel, made just for you.

name: Rekha- Pants - Petite
desc:
Crafted from 100% breathable 100% cotton, these trousers are designed for all-day comfort with a relaxed yet refined silhouette.  
They can be styled casually or dressed up for a more polished look—making them a versatile staple for both everyday wear and work.

name: Rekha- Top
desc:
Crafted from 100% breathable cotton, this tailored sleeveless top features clean lines and a soft striped texture. It is thoughtfully lined with soft malmal on the inside, adding an extra layer of comfort and a smooth feel against the skin. 
This piece is designed for versatility, easy to style for everyday wear, while still elevated enough for work or more put together moments.

name: Shanti
desc:
Crafted from breathable 100% cotton, this top features subtle mandala prints that add a meaningful yet understated detail to the design. 
A modern take on tradition, this cotton cholo-style top blends cultural elegance with everyday wearability 
Lightweight and comfortable, it’s perfect for warm days, holidays, getaways, or casual outings when you want something effortless but elevated.

name: Sital- Skirt
desc:
Crafted from 100% cotton, this skirt is designed for everyday comfort and effortless wear. Lightweight, breathable, and soft against the skin, it moves naturally with you throughout the day.

Its clean, minimal silhouette makes it endlessly versatile easy to dress up or down, across seasons and occasions.

name: Suti Thaili
desc:
Inspired by the simplicity of the traditional Nepali thaili, this carry bag is a modern take on an everyday essential. Made from 100% cotton, it is designed to be lightweight, and effortlessly practical. 
Accessories that can be paired up with any thing, perfect for holiday.

name: Tote bag
desc:
Sutine Everyday Tote is designed for everyday comfort. 
Crafted from durable, high-quality cotton , this bag is lightweight yet sturdy, perfect for daily essentials, work, or casual outings. With spacious compartments  easy-access pockets and  zipper for safety. it keeps your belongings organised while maintaining a minimal, elegant look. Perfect accessories for you everyday use.
